summary: Requires, as a Best Current Practice, that DNS messages be allowed to travel over TCP on the Internet, including unencrypted TCP and TLS. This matches the implementation requirements of RFC 7766. It discusses consequences and the operational issues that arise when it is not followed. It updates RFC 1123 and RFC 1536.

eli5.summary: DNS answers can come by a fast path or a sturdy path. Networks must leave the sturdy one open too.

questions: should firewalls allow dns over tcp
